heading: Featured Projects
subtitle: From multi-agent pipelines to evaluation tooling — problems I've taken from zero to production.

projects.title: Scale66
projects.goal: Help non-technical small business owners create platform-optimized social media content without marketing or design skills.
highlights: Pivoted from a no-code builder toward AI-generated social carousels after customer discovery across Michigan.
Built a 5-stage multi-agent pipeline: format selection → template matching → copywriting → image generation → style consistency.
Led a 4-person team with weekly meetings, GitHub Issues workflow, and eventually built the frontend myself.
Won $800 at Startup Garage pitch competition against 12 teams.

projects.title: EvalSync
projects.goal: Pull LLM-judge eval results from Langfuse into Notion or Excel for human grading and judge-vs-human agreement tracking.
highlights: Scoped aggressively with YAGNI — cut adapters, push mechanics, and kappa down to one focused MCP tool.
Single hard contract: every project emits one trace-level Langfuse score named judge_verdict.
Writes a 7-column table with match percent at the top — the harness reads, never runs evals.
Onboarding any new project costs almost nothing.

projects.title: AI News Digest
projects.goal: A daily digest of AI news filtered to what's actually relevant to my work — stay current without the noise.
highlights: Built in under two days, still in daily use — a see-a-problem, build-it-myself moment.
Chose battle-tested scraping and delivery over flashy methods to avoid production failures.
Multi-agent pipeline: scraping → summarization → ranking → email delivery.
Async ingestion so the pipeline never blocks.

projects.title: Ultra Deep24
projects.goal: An onboarding voice agent for the Ultra student platform that gathers student info, guides next steps, and improves opportunity matching.
highlights: Ultra ran four separate pipelines for college, internships, research, and entrepreneurship — never holistic.
The onboarding bot unifies intake and recommends which area to pursue first.
Designed to show value first, then communicate it clearly to the founder.
Project plan and documentation structured in Notion.

projects.title: Docent AI
projects.goal: Let users describe a real-life situation, identify which capital vices sit at the root, and give advice drawn from Rebecca DeYoung's Glittering Vices.
highlights: Diagnoses deeper source vices, not single acts — grounded in DeYoung's framework.
End-to-end RAG: 512-token chunks, 64-token overlap, OpenAI embeddings, pgvector cosine retrieval.
Source-cited streaming answers over SSE with a frontend polling state machine.
Companion app: A Virtue a Day (React Native + Expo for iOS/Android).
